title: Integer overflow in total_aggregated_routes() sum
description:
File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs
Lines: 442-448

The routes_learned values are summed without overflow checking:

```rust
let mut total: u32 = peers.values().map(|g| g.routes_learned).sum();
if let Some(ref local) = self.local_gateway {
    total += local.routes_learned;
}
```

Trigger: Federation with many gateways where sum of routes_learned exceeds u32::MAX (4.2 billion). Example: 100 gateways each reporting 50 million routes.

Bad behavior:
- Debug build: panics on overflow
- Release build: silently wraps, returning wildly incorrect count (e.g., 0)

Fix: Use saturating_add() for the final addition and Iterator::try_fold() or checked arithmetic for the sum, or return u64.
